purpose: Use measured pagination plus current KDP cost evidence to determine what still matters before choosing a trim.

official_kdp_evidence_2026_09_30.large_trim_definition: more than 6.12 inches wide or more than 9 inches high
official_kdp_evidence_2026_09_30.consequence_for_current_candidates: All three measured Sleepy Hollow candidates are regular trim and under 110 pages, so current Amazon.com printing cost is the same $2.30 fixed cost for each.

end_user_operator_evidence.useful_pattern: Recent self-publishing discussions repeatedly describe 5.5x8.5 as a comfortable fiction/trade-paperback size, while some prefer 5x8 and others 6x9. Physical feel and genre expectations are treated as real decision inputs rather than a universal winner.
end_user_operator_evidence.implication: Do not convert community preference into a hard master rule.

why_not: The three current prototypes have identical Amazon.com black-ink printing cost.
Reader aids have not yet been inserted, so final pagination/density is not known.
Operator evidence on physical preference is mixed.
No physical proof copy has yet been evaluated.
